conventions.zero_bend_controls: not in line-F1; every predicted line counted as a false positive
conventions.gold_tiers: GOLD11 (owner-verified except C05/C06 Codex multiview), GOLD_LINES_HUMAN_NON_GOLD11 (owner-verified), AI_GOLD_ACCEPTED (agent-adjudicated)
